title: Very light, cheaply made.
text: Very light, cheaply made.. I cannot believe I paid nearly $30 for this. It is so cheap and light it broke within a day or so, then totally disappeared except for some of the beads. Then yesterday I stopped by our local Dollar Store, and there was the exact product for 99c. S

product_metadata.title: St Saint Benedict Rosary w/Case Truly Blessed by Pope Benedict XVI on 6/1/2011
description: This rosary was Blessed by Pope Benedict XVI at the Vatican in Rome, Italy on June 1, 2011. A laminated parchment of the Blessing given is included. The blessing I give to you. Also a copy of the ticket received was taken in front of the Vatican to show you that the item was truly Blessed. Each person whom attends a Wednesday Audience get a ticket with a number on it and no one else would have that number that day. Included too is a card stock copy of a photo taken of the Pope riding in the Pope Mobile thru the crowds gathered at the audience that day.
